data.name: TUBx Tactical
data.detailed_description:
TUBx Tactical brings back the golden era of fast-paced, highly repeatable arcade shooters. Strip away the fluff and dive straight into high-stakes PvP combat designed to test your reflexes and reward tactical gunplay. Whether you are settling scores in an intimate 1v1 showdown or running back your favorite classic game modes in massive lobbies with friends, every round delivers instant action.

Choose Your Operator

Drop into battle as one of 5 distinct elite members of the TUB (Tactically Unified Brotherhood). Align with the tactical precision of the Crusader Intelligence Division (C.I.D.) or deploy with the brutal efficiency of the Levant Forward Command (L.F.C.).

Build Your Ultimate Loadout

With over 20+ weapons and equipment options, you can adapt to any combat scenario. Tweak your firearms to perfectly match your personal playstyle:

  • Tactical Attachments: Equip game-changing sights like thermal scopes or illuminate dark corners with glowsticks.

  • Personal Expression: Flex on your friends by tricking out your favorite weapons with a massive variety of collectible weapon charms.

Retro-Inspired Arenas

Battle across 7 custom maps meticulously designed to pay homage to the greatest shooters from back in the day. Each arena features tight choke points, vertical lanes, and nostalgic layouts optimized for maximum replayability and non-stop firefights.

data.short_description: Drop into TUBx Tactical, a fast-paced, classic-inspired arcade FPS built for pure PvP action. Battle your friends in intense 1v1 duels or scale up to chaotic large-lobby modes. Customize your loadout from 20+ weapons, attach game-changing gear like thermal scopes and glow sticks. Get in the TUB!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 17 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2080 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: The game depicts guns and some mild blood elements when fighting other players.
